findings.design: A top-right 'Export CSV' button (transparent, bordered, rMd radius) sits beside the append-only caption row, letting an admin export the log.
findings.app: absent — no export affordance anywhere in AdminAuditLog.vue or its composable/API client calls

findings.element: Privileged-action star marker + ActionBadge color coding
findings.design: ActionBadge renders the action in a colored monospace label (warn/poor/good/accent per action type) and appends a superscript ★ when `privileged` is true; the caption row explicitly defines '★ = privileged action' as the whole reason the screen exists per the artboard subtitle ('Privileged actions marked with a star').
findings.app: Action column renders `entry.action` as plain text with no color coding, no monospace, and no privileged flag/star at all — the underlying AuditLogEntry type has no `privileged` field to even source this from
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:341-359 (ActionBadge), :373 (star legend); apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminAuditLog.vue:65-67 (plain {{ entry.action }}); packages/shared/src/admin/index.ts:47-58 (AuditLogEntry has no privileged field)

findings.design: Six distinct columns in fixed order — Timestamp, Actor, Action, Target, Before, After — with Before/After shown as separate monospace cells for direct diffing.
findings.app: Five columns in a different order — Action, Target, Change, Actor, When — with Before/After collapsed into a single 'Change' string (`before → after`) via formatAuditDiff.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:379 (THead cols); apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminAuditLog.vue:49-55 (thead th order), :71-72 (formatChange merges before/after)

findings.design: A caption line above the table states 'Append-only · read-only' with a dot separator and '★ = privileged action' legend, communicating the immutability guarantee and badge meaning directly on screen.
findings.app: No such caption/legend text is rendered anywhere on the page.

findings.design: Relative/short timestamps ('Today 14:32', 'Jun 22 18:41') in a small subtle monospace font, keeping the log scannable.
findings.app: Absolute long-form date via Intl.DateTimeFormat (e.g. 'Jan 1, 2026, 02:32 PM'), plain (non-mono) text.

findings.design: Table wrapped in a surfaced card: `T.surface` background, 1px border, `rXl` rounded corners, overflow hidden, with an elevated-background uppercase-letter-spaced header row.
findings.app: Bare `<table>` with only a bottom border on `<thead>`/rows — no card background, no border, no rounding, no uppercase header styling.

findings.design: Section header is a full-width bar with `T.elevated` background, bottom border, and `14px 28px` padding, matching the other admin screens (Sources, Users, Review queue).
findings.app: Just an `<h1>` text node with no surrounding bar/background/border — inconsistent with the other admin section headers in the same shell.

findings.design: When `actor === 'system'`, the actor cell is italicized and rendered in a subtler muted tone to visually distinguish automated entries from human admins.
findings.app: Actor cell falls back to the literal string 'System' when `actorEmail` is null but applies no italic/muted styling distinction.

findings.design: Artboard depicts a fixed, single-page, scrollable log (7 rows fill the 820px frame) with no pagination controls.
findings.app: Adds an `AdminPagination` control driven by `meta.total`/`meta.limit`, not represented in the design at all.
